transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Yeah, um... I came in because for a long time now, I've just been walking around with this flat, heavy feeling. It's like, even when work is going okay or people are being nice to me, I still just feel down. I just feel kind of empty most days, to be honest, and I figured I should finally talk to someone about it.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
Well, it's been going on for about two years and two months now. It pretty much started ever since this dashboard project put me in the spotlight at work.
Did this down, empty feeling start because of what happened with that dashboard project at work?

I'm not really sure if it was because of it, to be honest. It's just... that's when the timing lines up. I don't know if the project actually caused me to feel this way, or if it was just a coincidence. It's just around that time that I really started noticing this feeling settling in, and it hasn't gone away since.
During these past two years, have you felt down or empty on most days?

Yeah, pretty much. Like I was saying before, it's just this flat, heavy feeling most days. Even if work goes fine or people are being nice to me, I just feel down and... empty, I guess. It's really constant.
During the past two years, was there ever a period of at least two weeks when your depression got noticeably worse than your usual baseline?

No, not really. It's just been pretty much the same... steady, low feeling the whole time. I don't remember it ever suddenly getting a lot worse for a couple of weeks or anything like that. It's just always there, kind of at the same level.
Do you think your low mood is mainly because of problems or stress at work?

I don't think so. I mean, work can be stressful sometimes, but I don't think it's the main reason I feel this way. Like I said, even when things are going fine at my job, I still have that same empty feeling. So, no, I wouldn't say it's just because of work stress.
Over this period, have you been struggling with low self-esteem?

Yeah, I definitely do. It's like... well, for example, when people at work still bring up this dashboard I built a while back, my first thought is usually that I just somehow fooled them. And then whenever I make a small mistake, like a missed follow-up or a late email, it just feels like... proof that I'm not actually as capable as they think I am. So yeah, I guess I'm pretty hard on myself.
During these past two years, was there ever a stretch of two months or longer when you did not feel depressed?

No, I don't think so. It's been pretty constant. I mean, there might be a day or two here and there where I feel slightly less heavy, but definitely not a whole two months of feeling normal. It's just... always there.
